description: This file defines the 'Thumb' class within the Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Product namespace. The class extends the core Controller class and contains a method 'index' that prepares data for rendering a product thumbnail view, including URLs for cart, wishlist, and product comparison functionalities.

classes.name: Thumb
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling product thumbnail display and related data preparation in the catalog section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates the data array with URLs and settings, then renders the product thumbnail view with this data.
